Container.Name: dubarr
Container.Overview: Removes audio and subtitle tracks in languages you don't want from your movies and TV, without re-encoding. Files with no audio in your language are left alone and flagged. Starts in report-only mode, keeps every original in a recycle folder with one-click restore, waits for torrents to finish seeding, and tells Radarr, Sonarr and Jellyfin about each change. Set everything up in the web UI. Free forever: no paid tiers, no Pro account, no subscriptions.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Dubarr web UI

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Your movie library, read/write. /mnt/user0 is the array-only view of your shares: with a cache pool, cleaned copies are then written straight to the array disk, not the cache (see the README). Use /mnt/user/... if your media share has no cache pool. Same folder as Radarr's, under any name.

Config.Name: TV
Config.Description: Your TV library, read/write. Same folder as Sonarr's. See Movies for why /mnt/user0.

Config.Name: Anime
Config.Description: Your anime library, read/write, if you keep one apart from TV. Same folder as Sonarr's anime root folder. Leave it empty or remove it if you don't have one. See Movies for why /mnt/user0.
